coral-wash.note: Qt alpha 20/255 behind invalid fields and error bubbles; the running STOP hover uses 28/255 (0.11).

strip-ground.note: Ground at the strip's opacity setting (default 85%); its hairline is rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.18) scaled by the same opacity.

tag-ground.note: Qt alpha 232/255 behind box tags; the picker's card uses 0.96 with a rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.27) border over a rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.59) screen dim.

display.purpose: The last answer only; 44pt shrinking to 14pt to fit.

brand.purpose: The text title MASSAB in the rail; also the taskbar M.

headline.purpose: Uppercase page title in the header.

title.purpose: The answer's total time on the slab.

body.purpose: Setting names, riddle text, chat, explanations.

body-hint.purpose: Hints under setting names and panel titles, in Tertiary Text.

label.purpose: Panel titles, status line, buttons; uppercase.

label-small.purpose: Chips, small buttons, segmented cells; uppercase.

data.purpose: Field values, drop-downs and the activity log.

extensions.shadowsNote: None. The system is flat; depth is value steps (ground, panel, raised) and 1px rules.

motion.name: spring-rail
motion.kick: 12 px/s per px of travel, max 600 px/s
motion.purpose: The rail's selection block springing to the chosen tab; overshoots about 4-5px on a one-tab move.

motion.name: spring-hop
motion.purpose: Page enter: later tabs rise from below, earlier ones drop from above; overshoots about 5px.

motion.name: spring-hop-leave
motion.purpose: The old page's snapshot fades out and drifts away.

motion.name: spring-segmented
motion.purpose: The segmented control's ink block sliding to the chosen cell.

motion.name: spring-grow
motion.purpose: The timing bar growing from zero on a new answer.

motion.name: spring-model
motion.value: stiffness (2*pi/duration)^2, mass 1, damping ratio 1 - bounce; retargets keep current velocity; 8ms ticks
motion.purpose: How every spring is computed (theme.spring_state and theme.Spring). The cubic-beziers above are web approximations.

motion.name: motion-setting
motion.purpose: Off, or Windows with Windows' animation effects off, makes every spring jump to its end and skips page hops.

breakpoints.name: columns-stack

extensions.units: Sizes are Qt points (pt) and px; Qt style-sheet alphas (0-255) are converted to CSS decimals here.

narrative.overview:
MASSAB is laid out like a black instrument sheet. Flat near-black planes are separated by 1px rules. Names, page titles and the answer are set in tall condensed poster type, and every label, number and log line is in crisp monospace. Nothing glows and nothing is glass. There is no light source, so depth comes only from value steps and lines. The one bright object is the light slab holding the last answer, and that's where the eye goes first.

The window is dense but calm, a setup and review console. The player glances at it, presses START, and goes back to the game. Everything drawn over the game follows the same rules: dark, square and white-lettered, and it never gets in the way. Motion is springy and brief, in the style Apple describes: springs set by duration and bounce that keep their velocity when interrupted, that move in the direction of the page you're going to, and that can be turned off.

This replaces the earlier dark-glass console. Glows, gradients, glass panels and rounded capsules are confirmed rejections.
keyCharacteristics: Flat near-black planes stepped by value (ground, panel, raised), cut by 1px rules.
Square geometry: 2px corners on framed controls, true squares on painted controls.
Big Shoulders Display for names and the answer, Martian Mono in capitals for every label and number, and Segoe UI Variable for sentences.
One light slab per screen, and it holds the last answer.
Color is a signal, never decoration: mint, amber and coral each carry one meaning.
Spring motion with bounce at or under 0.35, which snaps into place when motion is off.

rules.name: The One Slab Rule
rules.body: The last answer sits on the only light surface on screen. No other panel, banner or card may be light.

rules.name: The Signal Rule
rules.body: Mint means live or pasted, amber means guess or loading, coral means stop, error or low VRAM. A signal color is never decoration, and a meaning is never shown in any other color.

rules.name: The Ice Is Focus Rule
rules.body: Focus Ice draws focus rings and nothing else: no fills, no text, no selected states.

rules.name: The Mono Readout Rule
rules.body: Every label, number, button, chip and log line is in Martian Mono, in capitals where it labels something. Big Shoulders is reserved for the title, page titles, the total and the answer.

rules.name: The Lowercase Unit Rule
rules.body: Units stay lowercase inside capitalized mono text: "READ 0.42 s", "0.94 s", "15 ms". Capitalize the label, never the unit.

rules.name: The No Light Source Rule
rules.body: Nothing casts a shadow, glows or is lit by a gradient. To separate two things, step the value or draw a 1px rule.

rules.name: The Square Rule
rules.body: Corners never go above 2px. There are no pills, no circles and no capsules: a status light is a 7px square, and a toggle knob is a 13px square.

dos: **Do** separate surfaces only with the three value steps (ground, panel, raised) and 1px rules.
**Do** keep the answer slab the one light surface on screen, and give the last answer Display type on it.
**Do** set every label, button, chip and number in Martian Mono capitals, with units left lowercase ("READ 0.42 s").
**Do** flag every guess in amber, and show PASTED next to it when a guess was pasted. Never let one replace the other.
**Do** keep anything drawn over the game dark, square and white-lettered, and make it impossible to click or focus. The picker is the one exception, and only while dragging.
**Do** drive motion with springs defined by duration and bounce, with bounce at or under 0.35, and carry the current velocity into any retarget.
**Do** move pages along their tab order: later tabs come from below, earlier ones from above.
**Do** snap every spring to its end when Animations is Off, or when it's set to Windows and Windows' animation effects are off.
**Do** keep feedback brief and exact: state changes show up as a square light, a chip or a one-line mono status, not a dialog.
donts: **Don't** use shadows, glows, gradients, blur or glass anywhere.
**Don't** round past 2px or use pills, circles or capsules. Lights, knobs and swatches are squares.
**Don't** use Focus Ice for anything except focus rings.
**Don't** use mint, amber or coral decoratively, or show one of their meanings in another color.
**Don't** add a second light slab, banner or card. The light surface belongs to the answer.
**Don't** use Big Shoulders for labels or body text, or Segoe for numbers.
**Don't** use bounce above 0.35, start a spring from zero velocity when it's interrupted mid-flight, or make motion that can't be turned off.
**Don't** add a logo or icon set. The title is text, and its letter M is the icon.
